# Fakhar Labs

> Fakhar Labs is a web development agency based in Pakistan. We design and build custom, fast, mobile-first websites for businesses, clinics, gyms, schools, startups and professional services.

## About

Fakhar Labs is a web development agency that builds custom websites using React, TypeScript and modern frameworks like Next.js and TanStack Start. We serve businesses across Pakistan — including Lahore, Gujranwala, Narowal, Islamabad, Faisalabad, Karachi and Sialkot — as well as international clients.

Every website is designed mobile-first, built for speed (targeting 95+ Lighthouse scores), and delivered with full source code ownership to the client.

## Services

- **Website Development**: Custom business websites built with React and TypeScript
- **Website Design**: UI/UX design for new websites and redesigns
- **Website Redesign**: Rebuild ageing websites into fast, modern, mobile-first experiences
- **Landing Pages**: Conversion-focused single-purpose pages for campaigns
- **Website Maintenance**: Ongoing security updates, monitoring and content changes
- **Custom Web Applications**: Portals, dashboards, booking systems and integrations
- **Clinic Website with Booking System**: Online appointment booking for doctors, dentists and clinics
- **Gym Website with WhatsApp Booking**: Fitness websites with one-click membership inquiry
- **E-commerce Website Development**: Online stores with payment gateway integration

## Portfolio Highlights

- **Kids Care Clinic**: Pediatric clinic platform with online booking, video consultations, admin dashboard (React, Tailwind CSS)
- **Iron Man Gym**: Fitness website with WhatsApp booking for a Narowal gym
- **Fitness Arena Gym**: Premium gym website for an Islamabad fitness center
- **Doctor Fitness Club**: Modern gym website with WhatsApp booking
- **Dental Parlor**: Dental clinic website with WhatsApp appointment inquiry in Islamabad
- **Dr. Amna Physiotherapy**: Physiotherapy clinic website (under construction)
- **Tiny Tool Kit**: 20+ free web tools in one app
- **The Case Converter**: Free online text case conversion tool
- **Shift Canvas**: Private, offline-capable background remover

## Technology Stack

- React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Start
- Tailwind CSS v4
- Vite 8, Nitro (SSR)
- Supabase (database)
- Vercel (deployment)
- Clerk (authentication)

## Pricing

Starting prices for website development:
- Basic (up to 4 pages): PKR 6,999 (~$25 USD)
- Professional (up to 8 pages): PKR 13,175 (~$47 USD) — 15% launch discount
- Business (up to 15 pages): PKR 21,250 (~$76 USD) — 15% launch discount

All prices are starting points. Final pricing confirmed after scope agreement.
